Hello, I am a huge fan of your work! I love how you draw women! 🩷

My apologies for my first request, I totally get if this one isn't okay. Sorry and thank you for your time. 😖😣🙏  
I am not sure if it is possible, but I would love for you to draw a feminine character with pink and long hair, with a fringe.  
For the outfit, I would love something J-fashion inspired, " lovecore " themed. Feminine clothes, frilly and cute! I love anything pink & red combo with lots of love & heart themed ! Like something Valentine's Day themed. Pink is my favourite colour, feel free to add lots of it ! 
Feel free to choose I love your artstyle so much !!
For the pose, feel free to choose it be it love themed or a warm, gentle pose. Feel free to choose 💞  If possible (if it is too much work, you do not have to! Only if possible, just the person is enough 💞) 
I would love if you could also draw my two bunnies Honey & Daisy even with cute accessories feel free to choose, even their poses) 🥰   

For the background, something simple & pink is enough 🫶 
  I would love to use it as SNS icon and I would love to print it for myself, of course, so that I can stare at it everyday if allowed.   

Thank you for your work, and your time,  and sorry again it is my first time using skeb, I hope I am using it right this time!

Sending lots of love from France 🩷🤍🧡🐰
